create_trie_split_text: create a Trie to split text on added tokens matching the longest word first

test_tokenize_text: test tokenizing text into a sequence of tokens using slow Python tokenizers with added token support
review_truncate_sequences: review truncating sequences with strategies like only_first, only_second, or longest_first
summarize_save_vocabulary: summarize saving tokenizer vocabulary and BPE merges to JSON and text files
